card.name: The 'ptic' in aseptic technique
card.fires_on: The final piece 'ptic' of the word 'aseptic', right after 'ase'. It appears in preparation and handling instructions such as 'using aseptic technique'.

modes.label: Aseptic technique
modes.description: Completes 'aseptic' in instructions for preparing or transferring injectable products.
